english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose noun for the crops obtained or the farming result.
Use this for the amount harvested in a season, not the plant itself.

examples.english: This year's rice harvest is pretty good.
examples.jyutping: gam1 nin4 di1 dou6 mai5 sau1 sing4 m4 co3

examples.english: This year's rice crop is pretty good.
examples.jyutping: gam1 nin4 di1 dou6 mai5 sau1 sing4 m4 co3
